literal: Justice deviating, king if acts, raindrop deviating, will not happen sky raining.
translation: If a king deviates from justice in his rule, the raindrops will deviate from their nature and the sky will fail to rain.
modern: மன்னவன் நீதி முறை தவறி ஆட்சி செய்தால், மழைத்துளிகளும் தம் இயல்பிலிருந்து மாறி வானத்திலிருந்து பெய்யாமல் போகும்.
explanation: This couplet draws a direct parallel between the moral order of a kingdom and the natural order of the world. The word 'முறை' refers to justice, and 'கோடி' means bending or deviating. If a king bends the rules of justice in his governance, nature itself will deviate from its course. Consequently, the raindrops ('உறை') will fail, and the sky will refuse to pour down its showers, showing that unjust rule disrupts the very elements that sustain life.
